intro: Angry kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces for every level of mad — mild annoyance, puffed-up rage, and full table flips. An angry kaomoji such as (ノಠ益ಠ)ノ or (¬_¬) is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and chats. Browse by intensity below and click any face to copy it instantly. However you search it — angry kaomoji or kaomoji angry — every face here is free to copy and paste.
